notes.title: [PLAYTEST] Steam Playtest Sign-Up Now Open!
notes.notes: [p][b]THANKS, LIGHT. – Steam Playtest Sign-Up Now Open![/b][/p][p]Hello from Lightersgames! Our closed Steam Playtest is now-live.[/p][p]Apply now to be among the first to play [b]every currently playable level[/b]—from the tutorial to the newest in-development stages.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]🔍 How to apply[/h3][olist][*][p]Click the Google-Form button below.[/p][p][url="https://forms.gle/JpTJdjuBsp54MusK7" style="button"]Tell us why you want playtest it.[/url][/p][/*][*][p]We’ll email you a Steam key—download, play, enjoy![/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3]🛠 Selection priorities[/h3][list][*][p][b]Feedback-driven[/b] – willing to report bugs and share opinions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Word-of-mouth champions[/b] – happy to shout “This game is great!” on social or streams.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Just curious[/b] – that’s fine too! If the queue isn’t packed, you’re in.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]🐞 How to send feedback[/h3][list][*][p][url="https://discord.gg/HVf2nV7gzA"]Our Discord Server[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3276550/THANKS_LIGHT__DEMO/"]Write a review on the demo page[/url][/p][/*][*][p][url="https://forms.gle/W33fcbedE6we8t2cA"]Follow-up Google form[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Email us: [url="https://hb@lightersgames.com"]hb@lightersgames.com[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Create your own secondary content—videos, blogs, memes![/p][/*][/list][p]Bug screenshots or clips help us fix issues faster.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Your light helps develop [b]THANKS, LIGHT.[/b][/p][p]— Lightersgames[/p]
